CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  February 24, 2026

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. in Conference Room A of Alhambra City Hall.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Ankit Udani, Vice Chairman; Michael Daninger; Stanley Tsai; Jennifer Ng

  Absent:  Nora Hernandez

  Staff Present: Steve Kuchenski, Secretary/City Architect; Eric Martinez, City Architect
  Representative

C.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – February 10, 2026
  • Request: This is a request for the Design Review Board to approve
  the Minutes of the February 10, 2026, Regular Meeting of the Design
  Review Board.
  • Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve
  as submitted the Minutes of the February 10, 2026, Regular Meeting
  of the Design Review Board.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Board Member
  Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Hernandez

D.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-141
  • 301 East Main Street
  • Applicant: Miki Hayashi
  • Request: This is an application for two new wall signs on an existing
  1-story commercial building for a commercial tenant known as “Great
  Future Academy.”
  1
  02/24/2026
   •  Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following conditions for
  approval:
  1. Revise the proposed signage to vertically center the lettering
  in relation to the logo for both signs.
  2. Provide a height dimension for the proposed lettering on each
  of the two wall signs.

  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Board Member
  Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Hernandez

AGENDA
ITEM 3:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-167
  • 2415 South Fremont Avenue
  • Applicant: Esther Yang
  • Request: This is an application for exterior alterations to an existing
  1-story Colonial-style single-family residence.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. The applicant shall revise the proposed front entry door
  design to remove the sidelites.
  2. The applicant shall provide half-lite doors at the front entry.
  3. The doors may be finished in either white or blue, to be
  reviewed and approved by City Architect, provided the chosen
  color is consistent with and complementary to the existing
  building color palette.

  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  2
  02/24/2026
